name: Order of the Dragon
headerMeta: Golden era · Heavy Cavalry · charge/RTS-control · 310 leadership · Seasonal (T5)
pitch: A burst/pickoff cavalry unit best pulled out in siege chaos to melt one or two isolated units and leave — not a blob fighter. Its charge-momentum tech is the whole skill ceiling, and it dies fast if slowed, stunned, or stuck in a prolonged group fight.

battleRole.positioning: Deploy on the flank where the high skirmish (7/10) and flank (8/10) ratings matter — avoid prolonged 1v1 duels (3/10) and direct front-line infantry engagement. {1} Terrible in a blob fight: too many slows in the game, and if the unit gets stuck, stunned, or slowed by anything the whole unit is gone. {3} In sieges, pull it when there's chaos or disorganization and use it as a burst/pickoff tool on 1-2 isolated units, then leave rather than commit to a sustained fight. {3}
battleRole.tips: Press 1 for RTS view control mode: damage boost and charge stance {1}. Press 2 for sweep ability (like Khevtuul/Kriegsbruders): area threat {1}. Press 3 to heal: sustain for extended engagements {1}. Plan the route with Z first, which also helps deploy the unit closer to the action before using ability 1 {3}.

controls.notes: Ability loop: (1) RTS view for damage + charge stance, (2) sweep for area control, (3) heal for sustain. {1} Left-click cancel timing (place behind the unit, click on first slash, click again to cancel) is what preserves momentum for a wipe — most fights need this charge effect to land. {3} On a captured Tzsum replay, the hero-mounted variant rode in with the early push toward the outer palisade and stayed with its own retinue at the right gate rather than detaching solo, with artillery softening the gate approach ahead of the break-in. {2}

gaps: No matchups / counter units sourced — Amya's thread had no 'Counters' section; house how-to guide and replay notes give playstyle, not named matchups.
No formation guidance (F1/F2 etc) — structural absence across all sources.
Amya's guide last edited 2026-05-26, pre-dating the Chaos patch (2026-06-25) and thus potentially stale; unit is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so revalidation deferred.
No house-card variant exists for this unit (confirmed absence, not a capture gap).

'Dragon Cav' (the house nickname used in the how-to guide) is treated by house authors as a plausible-but-not-independently-confirmed match to Order of the Dragon; aliases.json arbitrates the match at the data layer, so it is folded in here, but the underlying guide never states the identity with certainty.
House 'ls' gear stat (787 quoted in a doctrine discussion) is not expanded in the source thread and isn't independently confirmed, so it's omitted rather than guessed.
